prompt: A 10-second stairwell ambush. Begin looking vertically down at the detective. During the first 2 seconds pedestal down while tilting up to eye level. Truck left with the detective from 2 to 7 seconds. At 7 seconds pan quickly left to reveal the pursuer behind the column, widening the lens and rolling right. After the 1.2-second reveal pan, counter-pan briefly right to include both principals by the end. Use one continuous take.
